body_markdown:
Tiny tummies need just as much support as adult tummies! Between outdoor playgrounds, seasonal colds, classroom germs, and whatever lands on the living room floor, kids have a knack for exploring the world hands-on. Behind every adventure, the[gut microbiome](https://lifewaykefir.com/probiotics-the-microbiome-and-a-strong-immune-system/) works around the clock to help keep children feeling their best. This internal ecosystem supports digestion, the immune system, skin, mood, and more, but it can’t do its best without the proper tools.


Probiotic-rich foods and foods with[prebiotic fiber](https://lifewaykefir.com/prebiotics-probiotics/) are two of the best nutrition-focused ways to care for the[microbiome.](https://lifewaykefir.com/probiotics-the-microbiome-and-a-strong-immune-system/) Along with eating plenty of fiber-rich fruits, veggies, and whole grains, probiotic foods[like kefir](https://lifewaykefir.com/benefits-of-lifeway-kefir/) support microbiome health by nourishing it with beneficial bacteria (the good bugs!) that help keep it thriving. That’s where[Lifeway ProBugs](https://lifewaykefir.com/family/probugs/) come in!


## Lifeway ProBugs: Gut Health Support On-the-Go for Little Ones


Lifeway ProBugs are[kefir pouches made for kids](https://lifewaykefir.com/family/probugs/) , and they’re packed with[beneficial probiotics](https://www.lifewaykefir.com/probiotics) and made with whole milk for optimal nutrition. Lifeway ProBugs support children’s gut health on-the-go, and it’s as simple as twist, sip, and enjoy. Our BPA-free kefir pouches are delicious, creamy, and made without any artificial ingredients. They make back to school time, seasonal changes, and stressed tummies easier to manage, as the live and active probiotics in Lifeway ProBugs work from within to support total body health.


## The Importance of the Microbiome for Children’s Health:


Think of the microbiome as a garden that needs the right soil to flourish optimally. When seeded with good bacteria (probiotics), it supports health in the following ways:


-


**Natural Defense System:** Roughly 70% of the immune system lives in the gut. A well-populated microbiome acts like an internal shield, helping keep seasonal bugs at bay.


-


**Better Digestion:** Beneficial cultures help break down nutrients so growing bodies can actually use them, keeping tummy troubles off the daily ailments list.


-


**The Gut-Brain Axis:** The[gut and brain are in constant communication](https://lifewaykefir.com/the-importance-of-nurturing-your-gut-health-for-better-mental-health/) via the vagus nerve. When digestion feels balanced and the gut is properly nourished, focus, mood, and energy levels follow suit.


## 3 Easy Ways to Enjoy Lifeway ProBugs Each Day


**1. The Grab-and-Go Lunchbox Hero:** Pop a ProBugs pouch into the freezer overnight; it doubles as an ice pack in the morning and thaws into a creamy smoothie by lunchtime.


**2. After-School Recharge:** Swap out sugary afternoon snacks for a chilled ProBugs pouch paired with crisp apple slices or a banana for a dose of probiotics and prebiotic fiber (from the fruit) in one go.


**3. Gut-Healthy Smoothie Base:** Squeeze a ProBugs pouch into the blender with a handful of fresh spinach, frozen strawberries, 1/2 a banana, and 1 tsp. chia seeds for a nutrient-rich, probiotic-packed breakfast on-the-go — no supplements required
